description: In common/mod.rs send_mdns (line 2383), the RFC 5322 MDN blob is built with a hardcoded Disposition line: 'manual-action/MDN-sent-manually; displayed'. The actual disposition from the request (mdn.disposition) is never used. This means: (1) the stored blob does not reflect the actual requested disposition type, (2) if a test ever parses the stored blob (e.g. a round-trip test), it would always see 'displayed' regardless of what was requested. No test currently parses the blob generated by send_mdns, so this bug is invisible. A comment explaining this limitation is absent.
title: mdn send_mdns blob ignores request disposition, hardcodes displayed
